title: curie build --plugin-dir --json
description: The `curie build --plugin-dir` receipt: one connector record per connector the bundle declared a `build:` for, in the order built. Always one object, even when the bundle declares nothing to build (#485): an empty `connectors` array is the honest 'nothing to build', distinguishable from a command that produced nothing.

name.description: The connector's declared name in connectors.yaml.

image.description: The resolved immutable identity recorded in connectors.lock.yaml: `<repo>@sha256:<64 hex>` for registry delivery, a bare `sha256:<64 hex>` image id for local-daemon delivery.

delivery.description: How the built artifact is delivered to a tier: pushed to a registry the cluster can pull, or loaded into the local Docker daemon.

platforms.description: The OCI platforms built, as declared (`os/arch`, optionally `/variant`).

source_digest.description: The digest of the build context as shipped (the connectors.lock.yaml `source_digest`), which stale-lock detection compares against a recomputation.
